historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission approved as amended conditional-use authorization for demolition of a single-story parking garage building and construction of a 5-story-over-basement mixed-use building with commercial space, 10 residential units, and 56 parking spaces, 6-0.
An existing single-story building used as a parking garage stood on the site.

The City Planning Commission approved, as amended, a modification of a previously authorized conditional use to permit construction of a seven-story building with 36 dwelling units over ground-floor retail at 1635 California Street.
